source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the accounting records.
2.
completion:
Correct accounting errors:
    1. Make an accurate list of all material historical accounting errors.

    1. Create a separate column for each such error in the loss estimate spreadsheet/document
    1. Estimate the financial effect of each such error in each increment of time (e.g. each "year" as reported in the misstatement spreadsheet)
    1. Estimate the cost of correcting each error over time, by updating accounting policies and procedures to be consistent with GAAP, including the associated costs for employee training and reconciliation of balances to prepare them for being restated.
    1. Reflect this information in the profits/losses column in the spreadsheet/document for each historical year.

        1. If a loss is included multiple times in different years, clearly explain when each loss was realized, and be sure it is included multiple times in the later accounting calculations.

    1. Reconcile the accounting records to the actual timeline of
